normalizations: Keep semantic request Accept/Content-Type and response Content-Type/Operation-Location headers; omit Python user-agent, credentials, request IDs, dates and transport-specific headers.
Retain every initial request, repeated Running poll and terminal result in source order; operation IDs, API versions, warnings, usage and all result fields are unchanged.

The request body is a scrubbed-binary marker, not original uploaded bytes. Go tests inject and exactly match explicit synthetic bytes; omit original Content-Length. No source-byte or valid-PDF upload evidence is claimed.

Source SDK submits JSON inputs to :analyze with application/json; its body was scrubbed. Adapt only that initial request to native :analyzeBinary with application/pdf and exactly matched explicit synthetic bytes. All response values/polls unchanged. This is a synthetic request adaptation, not original JSON-upload or recorded binary-service evidence.

SellerName.description: Legal or trade name of the company issuing the invoice

InvoiceNumber.description: Unique identifier assigned to the invoice for tracking and payment reference

InvoiceDate.description: Calendar date when the invoice was issued

DueDate.description: Calendar date by which payment is expected under the invoice terms

ServicePeriod.description: Start and end dates defining the period during which services were provided for this invoice

StartDate.description: First date of the billed service period

EndDate.description: Last date of the billed service period

CustomerName.description: Name of the customer organization being billed on the invoice

CustomerId.description: Identifier assigned to the customer account by the seller for billing and account matching

SellerAddress.description: Mailing address of the seller as printed on the invoice header

123 456th St
New York, NY, 10001

examples:

Redmond WA, 98052

examples:

123 Bill St,
Redmond WA, 98052

examples:

123 Ship St,
Redmond WA, 98052

examples:

Redmond WA, 98052

OrderInformation.description: Header-level order and shipping details associated with the invoice

Salesperson.description: Name or identifier of the salesperson responsible for the sale, if provided

PurchaseOrderNumber.description: Customer purchase order number referenced for this invoice

Requisitioner.description: Person or department that requested the purchase on the customer side, if provided

ShippedVia.description: Carrier or shipping method used for delivery, if provided

FobPoint.description: Free On Board point indicating where ownership and risk transfer, if provided

Terms.description: Payment or delivery terms printed in the order header, if provided

LineItems.description: Itemized charges billed on the invoice, typically one row per product or service

Date.description: Service or transaction date associated with the line item

ItemCode.description: Seller-defined code identifying the billed item or service

Description.description: Narrative description of the product or service billed on the line

Quantity.description: Number of units billed for the line item

UnitOfMeasure.description: Unit of measure for the quantity such as hours, pages, or each

UnitPriceAmount.description: Price per unit for the line item before tax

TaxAmount.description: Tax charged for the line item

LineAmount.description: Extended amount for the line item as billed on the invoice

SubtotalAmount.description: Sum of line item amounts before taxes and other adjustments

SalesTaxAmount.description: Total sales tax charged on the invoice

TotalAmount.description: Total invoice amount including taxes and other charges before applying prior balances or payments

PreviousUnpaidBalanceAmount.description: Outstanding balance from prior invoices carried forward onto this invoice

AmountDueAmount.description: Total amount currently due, typically including current invoice total plus any prior unpaid balance

RemitToAddress.description: Name and address where payment should be remitted
examples:

123 Remit St
New York, NY, 10001

command_expectation.derivation: Both pinned Python frontends executed independently of Go under VCR playback; all source interactions consumed by each frontend. Full reports retained; only the explicitly declared frontend differences are permitted when cross-checking them.
native_differences: Azure's configured profile selects gpt-4.1; Python azd and native starter use gpt-5.2. All other schema members equal, with no field/description/config filtering.
